:::{#sol-matrix-equality-practice}

Both [matrices](#def-matrix) are $2 \times 2$,
so they are [equal](#def-matrix-equality) when their entries in each position agree.
Three positions already agree,
and the entries in position $(1, 2)$ give

$$
\ba
x + 1 &= 4
&& \text{(@def-matrix-equality)}
\\
x &= 3.
&& \text{(subtract } 1 \text{ from both sides)}
\ea
$$

:::
